messages.content: How is the air quality in Los Angeles right now?

function.name: plant_biomass
function.description: Calculate the biomass of a plant species in a given area. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

species_name.description: The name of the plant species.

area.description: The area of the forest in square kilometers. This is a float type value.

density.description: The density of the plant species in the area. Default is average global density. This is a float type value.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live air‑quality data. For the most up‑to‑date information you might check the AirNow website (airnow.gov), the EPA’s Air Quality Index app, or local news outlets that report on LA’s air‑quality conditions.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "How is the air quality in Los Angeles right now?" We need to provide an answer. There's no tool for real-time data. We can respond with a general statement or ask if they want more details. According to policy, we should not fabricate real-time data. We can say we don't have real-time data. We could suggest checking official sources.
